board_generations: G1 (2017?-2019): hand-chalked blackboards in light wooden frames, white capitals, prices with apostrophe (3'50€); boards DESAYUNOS+MERIENDAS, MENÚS ENSALADAS, ENSALADAS (cut off). Seen only in p135 (EXIF 2019-02-08); 2017-18 receipts (p125, p164) belong to this era. G2 (~2020/21 - spring 2023): pine-wood boards with printed brown lettering, white arrow banners, icon combos, prices on separate stickers/patches; five boards Desayunos, Menús, Ensaladas, Tostas y Sándwich, Zumos y Licuados + Smoothies. Seen in p162 (COVID masks, est. 2021-22, fully readable at 8000 px by consolidator B), p011/p013 (2022-07) and the bottom strips in p119 (2023-04). G3 (by 2023-10 - at least 2025-11): black printed chalk-style boards with colour icons and yellow prices, same five-board layout (Desayunos hasta las 11:00h, Menús, Tostas y sándwich, Ensaladas, Zumos/Smoothies). Seen in p158 (2023-10-11), p149 (est. late 2023/early 2024) and p012 (2025-11-15, newest but almost unreadable through glass). Vitrina price tags: white printed cards with black/grey zig-zag band in wooden blocks, constant from 2023-02 (p056) to 2025-11 (p166); upper-shelf cards in p158 use a condensed variant. Receipts: PANPAN / PANBER CAFE, S.L. till tickets 2017-2024, IVA 10 %, with pinpad block from 2023.
